findings.text: follow-on: _load_conventions_yaml copies the body of the existing _load_yaml owner at vocab_loaders.py:33 rather than reusing it, so YAML reading has two owners three lines apart; the brief asked for reuse of _load_yaml.

follow-on: test_malformed_template_entry_is_refused matches only "templates.yml", a substring every templates refusal message carries, so it cannot distinguish the malformed-entry path from the unknown-segment-kind refusal and asserts less than the done-when's failing-by-name.

item_verdicts.diff: read one by one; the single commit 1e12625 adds the three YAML files, the conventions loaders and their pydantic models in vocab_loaders.py, the select_conventions accessor and its Applied* models in terms.py, tests/grammar/test_conventions.py, and the evidence fragment, with no change to any existing entry's definition.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names refusal of one malformed entry per file, one unknown token key and one forbidden spelling equal to a registered alias, plus the accessor returning exactly the seed entries, plus a scratch-copy removal that fails the accessor test; tests/grammar/test_conventions.py:64,79,94,110,126,143 assert every refusal, :166 asserts the exact entry sets, and the manifest's negative-control log shows the scratch removal failing that test with EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is the conventions registry (three files under imas_standard_names/grammar/vocabularies/conventions/), its token-validating loader in imas_standard_names/grammar/vocab_loaders.py:762-843, and the parse-selecting select_conventions accessor in imas_standard_names/grammar/terms.py:235; every seed entry (flux_surface_averaged, plasma_boundary, the density notation and the density template) is transcribed exactly as briefed.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records base 469 passed EXIT=0 and head 481 passed EXIT=0, the negative control 1 failed EXIT=1, the measurement module under /tmp scratch, and its changed_paths match the diff exactly.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is the source and test paths plus pyproject.toml if needed and the evidence fragment/figure paths; git diff --name-only 264aa2e..1e12625 lists seven paths, every one inside the declaration, each new file created rather than overwriting a cumulative record.

justifications.durability: tests/grammar/test_conventions.py:166 reddens when the flux_surface_averaged concept entry is removed (negative_control.log EXIT=1), and :110/:126/:143 each fail only if their named refusal stops firing, but :106 matches only the filename every templates.yml refusal carries.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed manifest records tests/grammar/test_conventions.py plus the eighteen importers found by rg and tests/test_codegen_drift.py at 481 passed EXIT=0, a base arm at 469 passed EXIT=0, and a negative-control log EXIT=1 whose header names the scratch tree and module path.
justifications.fit: the loaders sit on vocab_loaders.py beside _load_yaml and reuse _load_flat_token_list, the accessor sits on terms.py beside fetch_standard_terms, and no plan or stage label appears, though terms.py:18 imports the private _vocabulary_definitions across modules.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_standard_names/grammar/terms.py:235 select_conventions selects entries from the parse via _ir_tokens at terms.py:143, and vocab_loaders.py:762-843 enforce the token, alias, restatement and malformed refusals the goal names.
justifications.reuse: vocab_loaders.py:40 _load_conventions_yaml duplicates the body of the existing owner _load_yaml at vocab_loaders.py:33 instead of reusing or generalising it, while the remaining additions extend existing owners.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff --name-only 264aa2e..1e12625 lies inside the declared write paths, though docs/evidence/fragments/concept-and-notation-registry/cnr-registry-loader.html was written although the brief stated no evidence fragment was required.
